# marshall houston

> exploring creativity, ai, and how we write the future together.
> exploratory writing, ideas in flight, and small tools.

voice is lowercase, fragmented, first-person. exploratory not conclusive.
cross-domain references are a feature.

## writing
- [posts](https://marshallhouston.wtf/): essays and notes
- [kernels](https://marshallhouston.wtf/kernels): one-sentence ideas, some sprouted into posts
- [talks](https://marshallhouston.wtf/talks): conference talks
- [influences](https://marshallhouston.wtf/influences): what shaped the thinking
- [tags](https://marshallhouston.wtf/tags): browse by topic

## about
- [about](https://marshallhouston.wtf/about): who marshall is
- [cosmic farmland](https://cosmicfarmland.wtf): the apps and tools
